info.title: CAP-004 Risk Management API — Overdraft Assessment (JRN-016)
info.description: CAP-004 (Risk Management) does not expose a new REST API surface for JRN-016. SVC-012 (Risk Engine) participates in JRN-016 exclusively via async event consumption: consumes OverdraftReviewTriggered (EVT-114), performs credit assessment, and publishes OverdraftAssessmentCompleted (EVT-115). No synchronous channel call to CAP-004. This document confirms no new API endpoints are required.
info.x-note: No new CAP-004 API endpoints introduced by JRN-016. SVC-012 participates via async event consumption only. Internal SVC-012 -> EXT-BUREAU call is an external system integration, not a capability API.
